title: Nourishing Light Irish Snow Peas Bowl
description: A comforting and light Irish dish featuring snow peas, perfect for a sick day, served in a lacquerware bowl. This Buddhist-temple-friendly meal promotes rest and recovery.
instructions: Melt the unsalted butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the snow peas and cook for 2 minutes until they start to soften.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let cook for 5 minutes until the snow peas are tender.
Stir in the heavy cream and cook for an additional 2 minutes until heated through.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the snow pea mixture in a lacquerware bowl and top with grated cheddar cheese and chopped scallions.
